description: This Java class defines an Android Activity named ResultActivity, which displays a message when a notification is clicked. It provides UI handlers for snoozing and dismissing the notification, integrating with a service called PingService.

classes.name: ResultActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that handles user interactions from a notification, providing options to snooze or dismiss via the PingService.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and updates the UI with a message from the intent.

methods.name: onSnoozeClick
methods.description: Handles snooze button clicks by starting PingService with a snooze action.

methods.name: onDismissClick
methods.description: Handles dismiss button clicks by starting PingService with a dismiss action.
